en.title: Total of Suffix Subtractions by the Leftmost Nonzero Value
en.description:
You are given an array of non-negative integers. Repeatedly find the leftmost nonzero element; with its value x, process the elements from that position to the right one by one, subtracting x from an element only if its current value is at least x; in each round, add x to the total. Once the array is all zeros, output the total.

Standard input/output and this site's supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n integers. The source gives the value range 0≤a[i]≤10000; since direct simulation is O(n²), this site narrows n to 1≤n≤1000 so that it finishes within the time limit.
en.output: Output the total accumulated during the process, as one integer.
en.explanation: Simulate each round directly as described: locate the leftmost nonzero value x, add x to the total, and subtract x only from the elements in the suffix whose current value is not less than x.
